from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_rows = []
    row_colors = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        color, count = Counter(row).most_common(1)[0]
        if color != fill and count / w >= 0.70:
            line_rows.append(r)
            row_colors[r] = color
    # Marker intersections lie on those near-uniform separator rows; discard
    # plain framing rows, then retain columns changed from the separator color.
    rows = [r for r in line_rows if any(v != row_colors[r] for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != row_colors[r] for r in rows)]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        raise ValueError('encoded lattice not found')
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        outrow = []
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            a = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                 grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            outrow.append(a[0] if a.count(a[0]) == 4 else fill)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
PY

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The repeated lattice separator is the most common non-fill color.
    line = max((v for v in counts if v != fill), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == line for x in grid[r]) >= 0.70 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= 0.70 * h]
    # Colored deviations mark the portion of the lattice to decode; keep all
    # regularly spaced separators within that bounding rectangle.
    marked = [(r, c) for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] != line]
    if not marked:
        raise ValueError('no colored lattice marks')
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, _ in marked), max(r for r, _ in marked)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for _, c in marked), max(c for _, c in marked)
    rows = [r for r in rows if rmin <= r <= rmax]
    cols = [c for c in cols if cmin <= c <= cmax]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        outrow = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            outrow.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 else fill)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
PY

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = max((v for v in freq if v != fill), key=lambda v: freq[v])

    # Lattice vertices lie on the dominant horizontal/vertical line color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == line for x in grid[r]) >= 0.60 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= 0.60 * h]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] != line]
    if not marks:
        raise ValueError('no marked lattice vertices')
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marks), max(r for r, _ in marks)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marks), max(c for _, c in marks)
    rows = [r for r in rows if r0 <= r <= r1]
    cols = [c for c in cols if c0 <= c <= c1]

    # Each output cell is the color shared by its four lattice corners;
    # nonuniform corner patterns become the field/background color.
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        outrow = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb]]
            outrow.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    best = None
    for line in colors:
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) >= 0.70 * w]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= 0.70 * h]
        # The separator color is the one whose row/column lattice contains
        # the most non-separator vertex marks.
        marks = [(r, c) for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] != line]
        score = len(marks)
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, line, rows, cols, marks)
    score, line, rows, cols, marks = best
    if score == 0 or not rows or not cols:
        raise ValueError('no marked lattice found')
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marks), max(r for r, _ in marks)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marks), max(c for _, c in marks)
    rows = [r for r in rows if r0 <= r <= r1]
    cols = [c for c in cols if c0 <= c <= c1]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        outrow = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb]]
            outrow.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    best = None
    for line in colors:
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) >= 0.70 * w]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= 0.70 * h]
        # The separator color is the one whose row/column lattice contains
        # the most non-separator vertex marks.
        marks = [(r, c) for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] != line]
        score = len(marks)
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, line, rows, cols, marks)
    score, line, rows, cols, marks = best
    if score == 0 or not rows or not cols:
        raise ValueError('no marked lattice found')
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marks), max(r for r, _ in marks)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marks), max(c for _, c in marks)
    rows = [r for r in rows if r0 <= r <= r1]
    cols = [c for c in cols if c0 <= c <= c1]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        outrow = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb]]
            outrow.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
